sensor: ZED 2i internal IMU, /zed/zed_node/imu/data_raw, same mounting as the field sequence (user-confirmed)

engine_off_static.condition: engine off, same mounting, confirmed by user
engine_off_static.interval_reason: Discard first hour of warm-up and stop 57 seconds before the 10.5079-second gap at elapsed 31957.37 seconds. No post-gap data enter recommended parameters.
engine_off_static.white_noise_method: Overlapping rate Allan deviation; log-space fixed slope -1/2 over 0.1-1 seconds. Native ~399 Hz and every-fourth-sample ~100 Hz checked; all four phases agree. Field tick-spacing surrogate is an additional check. Scalar uses largest axis rounded to practical precision.
engine_off_static.random_walk_method: Provisional equivalent fixed +1/2 slope over 100-1000 seconds on native pre-gap data; K = geometric mean(ADEV * sqrt(3/tau)); max over axes separately for gyro and accelerometer. These fits include mixed flicker/drift and are not uniquely identified pure Brownian bias coefficients.
engine_off_static.rounding: largest axis, rounded up to two significant figures

engine_on_standstill.role: labelled sensitivity profile only (user decision 2026-10-21); never the Rule C input
engine_on_standstill.condition: engine running at fixed rpm, robot stationary, same mounting
engine_on_standstill.white_noise_method: same fixed slope -1/2 fit over 0.1-1 s on the delivered ~100 Hz stream, whole recordings
engine_on_standstill.selection: largest axis, then the larger of the two rpm settings, per quantity
engine_on_standstill.rounding: rounded up to two significant figures, as the engine-off reference
engine_on_standstill.random_walks: not identifiable from 20-30 min recordings; the profile keeps the engine-off random walks
engine_on_standstill.qualification: Engine vibration is periodic (free slopes -0.6 to -0.8, peaks at engine orders), so this density is an operating-condition amplitude, not a sensor calibration.
